name: Stormwork Irregular Cinema
description: The newest and most technically sophisticated underground studio operating in GLMZ, Stormwork Irregular Cinema emerged in 2219 with production quality that rivals licensed Tier 3 studios — an unprecedented achievement for an unlicensed operation. They produce politically charged neural-feed drama that blurs the line between fiction and documentary, depicting fictional corponation crimes with such specificity that multiple productions have been cited in actual grievance proceedings as 'circumstantial corroborating narrative.' Their funding source and technical infrastructure remain entirely unknown.
cultural_impact: Their emergence has destabilized the underground content ecosystem, with competing theories about whether they represent a genuine independent operation, a rival corponation's black-budget propaganda arm, or something else entirely.
story_hooks: Someone has hired the players to find out who is actually funding Stormwork Irregular Cinema — the client's identity is itself suspicious
A Stormwork production depicts an event that hasn't happened yet, in enough detail to constitute actionable intelligence
Stormwork has reached out directly to offer the players a role in their next production — as subjects, not collaborators
